entities.summary: Pierre A. Riffard is a French philosopher and specialist in esotericism. He has taught in the French overseas departments and territories and elsewhere: Asia, Oceania, Sub-Saharan Africa, Guiana. Riffard was a philosophers & thinkers from Toulouse (b. 1946-01-20, Toulouse). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
